tagline: Check your deck before you go on stage.
empty.title: Drop a .pptx file
empty.hint: SlideReady looks for fonts that will change, broken links, media that will not travel and forgotten text. Nothing is uploaded and your file is never changed.
drop.title: Drop the .pptx here
drop.error: I couldn't open this file. It must be a valid .pptx, not password-protected.
drop.large: This file is {size} MB and may take a while to open.
summary.allGood: No errors or warnings. Good luck!
fonts.empty: No fonts found in the text.
fonts.name: Font
fonts.status.risky: May be missing on the other computer
fonts.status.missing: Not installed here and not embedded
fonts.unknown: Cannot be checked in the browser
settings.title: Settings
about.title: About SlideReady
web.notice: Browser demo: I can't tell which fonts are installed or whether linked files exist.
limits.note: SlideReady estimates sizes inherited from the layout; when it cannot resolve one, it reports nothing.
issue.link-local-file.title: Link to a file on the author's computer
issue.link-local-file.body: The link points to {target}. That file will not exist on another computer and the click will fail.
issue.link-local-file.user: The path also shows the user name of whoever built the deck.
fix.link-local-file.win: Right-click the link, choose Edit Link and point it to a web address. Or put the content straight on the slide.
fix.link-local-file.mac: Control-click the link, choose Edit Hyperlink and use a web address. Or put the content straight on the slide.
fix.link-local-file.gs: Links to local files do not work in Google Slides. Upload the file to Drive and use the sharing link.
issue.link-malformed.title: Invalid link address
issue.link-malformed.body: "{target}" is not a valid address (a space in it or a wrong format). The link will not open.
fix.link-malformed.win: Right-click the link, choose Edit Link and fix the address.
fix.link-malformed.mac: Control-click the link, choose Edit Hyperlink and fix the address.
issue.link-slide-jump.title: Link to a slide that does not exist
issue.link-slide-jump.body: This link goes to a slide that was deleted.
fix.link-slide-jump.win: Insert > Link > Place in This Document and pick a slide that exists.
fix.link-slide-jump.mac: Insert > Hyperlink > This Document and pick a slide that exists.
issue.media-linked.title: Linked media that does not travel with the file
issue.media-linked.body: The file {target} lives outside the presentation. If you copy only the .pptx, it is gone.
issue.media-linked.missing: It does not exist on this computer either.
fix.media-linked.win: Delete the item and insert it again with Insert > Video (or Audio) > This Device so the file stays inside the presentation.
fix.media-linked.mac: Delete the item and insert it again with Insert > Video (or Audio) > Movie from File. In PowerPoint 365 this embeds the file.
issue.media-missing-part.title: Image or media missing from the file
issue.media-missing-part.body: The slide points to {target}, which is not inside the file. The item shows up empty.
fix.media-missing-part.win: Delete the empty frame and insert the image again.
fix.media-missing-part.mac: Delete the empty frame and insert the image again.
issue.media-format.title: Risky video format
issue.media-format.body: .{format} videos often fail in PowerPoint for Mac.
issue.media-format.old: .{format} videos often fail on older Windows versions.
fix.media-format.win: Convert the video to MP4 (H.264 with AAC audio) and insert it again. Free tools like HandBrake can do it.
fix.media-format.mac: Convert the video to MP4 (H.264 with AAC audio) and insert it again. QuickTime can export in that format.
issue.media-heavy.title: Heavy media
issue.media-heavy.body: One item is {size} MB. Large files are slow to open and hard to send.
issue.media-heavy.deck: The whole deck is {size} MB, which makes it hard to email and slow to open on older computers.
fix.media-heavy.win: File > Info > Compress Media, or lower the video resolution before inserting.
fix.media-heavy.mac: File > Reduce File Size, or lower the video resolution before inserting.
issue.font-not-embedded.title: Font that will change
issue.font-not-embedded.body: {font} is used on {count} slide(s), is not embedded in the file and is not installed on this computer. Where it is missing, the text switches font and may misalign.
fix.font-not-embedded.win: File > Options > Save > check "Embed fonts in the file". Plan B: File > Export > PDF.
fix.font-not-embedded.mac: PowerPoint > Preferences > Save > check "Embed fonts in the file". Plan B: File > Export > PDF.
fix.font-not-embedded.gs: Fonts in decks exported from Google Slides are not embedded. Switch to a safe font (Arial, Georgia, Verdana) or present from a PDF.
issue.font-risky.title: Font outside the safe list
issue.font-risky.body: {font} is used on {count} slide(s) and is not embedded. It is installed here, but it is not standard on every computer.
issue.font-risky.unknown: {font} is used on {count} slide(s) and is not embedded. I could not check whether it is installed, and it is not a standard font.
fix.font-risky.win: File > Options > Save > check "Embed fonts in the file", or switch to a safe font.
fix.font-risky.mac: PowerPoint > Preferences > Save > check "Embed fonts in the file", or switch to a safe font.
fix.font-risky.gs: Use a safe font (Arial, Georgia, Verdana) or present from a PDF.
issue.text-placeholder.title: Forgotten placeholder text
fix.text-placeholder.win: Replace it with the final text or delete the text box.
fix.text-placeholder.mac: Replace it with the final text or delete the text box.
issue.text-small.title: Text too small to project
issue.text-small.body: {count} run(s) from {size} pt. For people at the back of the room, body text should be at least 18 pt.
fix.text-small.win: Increase the font size or split the content across more slides.
fix.text-small.mac: Increase the font size or split the content across more slides.
issue.text-autofit-shrink.title: PowerPoint shrank the text to fit
issue.text-autofit-shrink.body: The text was reduced to {percent}% of its size. That means too much text for the box.
fix.text-autofit-shrink.win: Cut text or enlarge the box. Then set Format Shape > Text Options > Do Not Autofit.
fix.text-autofit-shrink.mac: Cut text or enlarge the box. Then set Format Shape > Text Options > Do Not Autofit.
issue.text-dense.title: Slide with a lot of text
issue.text-dense.body: {words} words and {bullets} bullet lines. The audience tends to read instead of listen.
fix.text-dense.win: Keep only the main ideas and move the detail to speaker notes.
fix.text-dense.mac: Keep only the main ideas and move the detail to speaker notes.
issue.a11y-alt-text.title: Image without alternative text
issue.a11y-alt-text.body: {count} item(s) without a description. Screen readers cannot describe them.
fix.a11y-alt-text.win: Right-click the image > View Alt Text and describe what it shows. If it is just decoration, check "Mark as decorative".
fix.a11y-alt-text.mac: Control-click the image > Edit Alt Text. If it is just decoration, check "Mark as decorative".
issue.a11y-no-title.title: Slide without a title
issue.a11y-no-title.body: Screen readers navigate by title; this slide has no name.
fix.a11y-no-title.win: Use a layout with a title (Home > Layout) and fill it in.
fix.a11y-no-title.mac: Use a layout with a title (Home > Layout) and fill it in.
issue.a11y-duplicate-title.title: Repeated title
fix.a11y-duplicate-title.win: Give the slides different titles so they can be told apart when navigating.
fix.a11y-duplicate-title.mac: Give the slides different titles so they can be told apart when navigating.
issue.a11y-table-header.title: Table without a header row
issue.a11y-table-header.body: Without a header row, screen readers do not know what each column means.
fix.a11y-table-header.win: Select the table > Table Design > check "Header Row".
fix.a11y-table-header.mac: Select the table > Table Design > check "Header Row".
issue.hygiene-hidden.title: Hidden slide
issue.hygiene-hidden.body: This slide is hidden and will not show in the presentation.
fix.hygiene-hidden.win: Right-click the slide > Hide Slide (uncheck) to show it, or delete it.
fix.hygiene-hidden.mac: Control-click the slide > Hide Slide (uncheck) to show it, or delete it.
issue.hygiene-comments.title: Review comments in the file
issue.hygiene-comments.body: {count} comment(s) on slides {slides}. Whoever gets the file can read them.
fix.hygiene-comments.win: Review > Delete > Delete All Comments in This Presentation.
issue.deck-aspect.title: 4:3 aspect ratio
issue.deck-aspect.body: The deck is 4:3. If the room's projector or TV is widescreen, black bars show at the sides.
fix.deck-aspect.win: Design > Slide Size > Widescreen (16:9) if the projector is widescreen. Check the result.
fix.deck-aspect.mac: Design > Slide Size > Widescreen (16:9) if the projector is widescreen. Check the result.
issue.contrast.title: Low-contrast text
issue.contrast.body: {count} run(s) at a contrast of {ratio}:1 or less (for example "{sample}"). On a projector, text below 4.5:1 washes out; below 3:1 nobody can read it.
fix.contrast.win: Pick a darker text color on a light background (or the reverse). Under Home > Font Color, prefer pure black or white.
fix.contrast.mac: Pick a darker text color on a light background (or the reverse). Under Home > Font Color, prefer pure black or white.
fix.contrast.gs: Select the text and use Text color in the toolbar to switch to a higher-contrast color.
issue.hygiene-off-slide.title: Object outside the slide area
issue.hygiene-off-slide.body: {count} object(s) fully or partly outside the slide (for example "{name}"). It does not show during the talk but stays in the file.
fix.hygiene-off-slide.win: Open the Selection Pane (Home > Arrange > Selection Pane), find the object and delete it or move it onto the slide.
fix.hygiene-off-slide.mac: Open the Selection Pane (Home > Arrange > Selection Pane), find the object and delete it or move it onto the slide.
issue.hygiene-metadata.title: Personal names in the file properties
issue.hygiene-metadata.body: The file stores these names: {people}. Anyone who gets the deck can see them.
fix.hygiene-metadata.win: File > Info > Check for Issues > Inspect Document > Remove All under Document Properties and Personal Information.
fix.hygiene-metadata.mac: File > Properties, clear the Author and Manager fields. Or Review > Protect > Remove personal information on save.
online.title: Online check
online.hint: Tests {count} address(es) from the deck. It is the only SlideReady action that uses the internet, and it runs only when you click.
online.unavailable: Available in the installed app only: a browser cannot test addresses on other sites.
links.empty: No links or media files in this deck.
issue.link-broken-online.title: Link that does not open
issue.link-broken-online.gone: {url} answered "not found" (code {status}). The page was removed or the address is wrong.
issue.link-broken-online.dns: The domain of {url} does not exist or could not be found.
issue.link-broken-online.unconfirmed: {url} did not answer as expected (code {status}). Some sites refuse automated tests, so it may work for whoever clicks. Open the link to check.
issue.link-broken-online.timeout: {url} did not answer within 8 seconds. It may be your connection or the site being down.
fix.link-broken-online.win: Open the link in a browser. If it is wrong, right-click the link, choose Edit Link and fix the address.
fix.link-broken-online.mac: Open the link in a browser. If it is wrong, Control-click the link, choose Edit Hyperlink and fix the address.
fix.link-broken-online.gs: Open the link in a browser. If it is wrong, select the text and press Ctrl+K to change the address.
